note: Only water-table -> DOC edges fit. e4 is reversed (soil OC -> wet site); e18 inundation -> CO2 emissions excluded as a flux, not soil carbon; e35 is decomposition rate, not soil carbon.

Only mounding counted as soil preparation before planting. Cover soil placement/type and soil amendment edges (e12, e15, e22, e36, e57, e60, e48) excluded as reclamation cover soil or amendments, not site preparation; composition-only edges excluded.

Only mechanical release (cutting competing vegetation) counted; 'cutting intensity/cutting treatments' in the same study are overstory harvest cuts and are excluded. Effects follow the measured variable (higher WUE and Amax = +1), which indicates less stress, not more; direction 'increase' refers to these physiological measures.

Doubtful class fit: shrub cover and perennial grass cover taken as competing vegetation. Vegetation suppression and manual cutting edges excluded as control interventions (other classes); suppression edges also report richness (S) and FD with contradictory treatment rankings.
Many herbicide -> species richness edges (e2, e3, e7, e13, e14, e17, e20, e26, e33, e39, e50, e55) excluded: richness is not a Shannon/evenness diversity index.

Harvest edges from 10.1002/hyp.13580 (e5, e8, e13, e24, e27 decreased; e28, e33, e52, e59 no change) concern weighted usable area, i.e. fish habitat, not fish populations. If habitat counted: decrease, moderate.
No temperature/microclimate -> invasive cover edge. Non-native cover edges (e15, e33, e49) have cover-soil causes; e54 is reversed (Cirsium monoculture -> soil temperature).

All herbicide edges report cover of single species or groups (native, non-native forbs, grasses) or bare ground, not total vegetation cover. If bare ground counted inversely (e17 -1, e48 -1, e10 0): decrease, moderate.
No fire -> fish edge among candidates.

Excluded: plant tissue nutrient edges (e19, e35, e38, e46, e58, e80, e3), lake sediment (organic status not stated: e11, e65), cover soils/donor material (LFH, PMM, peat cover soil), pH/EC. Straw study edges partly describe year-to-year changes; e32 is no-straw so sign flipped.
